info.title: ChronoFlow Meeting Actions
info.description: Prepare meeting/calendar event drafts for user review in ChronoFlow.

post.description: Prepare a meeting/calendar event draft for the user to review and confirm in ChronoFlow. Use when the user asks to schedule, set up, or book a meeting or event. ChronoFlow resolves attendee names to teammate emails, so pass names as the user said them. The user chooses Google or Teams calendar in the ChronoFlow UI.

durationMinutes.description: Meeting length in minutes. Defaults to 30 when omitted.

attendees.description: Attendee names or email addresses exactly as the user said them, e.g. ["sarah", "john@acme.com"].

location.description: Optional location for an in-person meeting.
